findings.title: Enable nix-command inside the workflow guard
findings.why_it_matters: The ci-workflow-docs-skip derivation fails before checking its matrix contract in a clean Linux build sandbox. The new subprocess uses the experimental nix eval command, but neither its arguments nor the derivation enable nix-command; the invoking developer or Actions runner's Nix configuration is not a declared sandbox input. Explicitly enabling the feature makes this pure expression evaluation independent of host configuration.
findings.suggested_fix: Invoke nix with --extra-experimental-features nix-command before eval, or set the feature explicitly in this derivation's NIX_CONFIG. Verify the guard with isolated Nix configuration and build checks.x86_64-linux.ci-workflow-docs-skip on Linux.
evidence: tests/check-workflow-docs-skip.sh:277 -- result = subprocess.run(["nix", "eval", "--json", "--expr", expr], text=True, capture_output=True)
flake.nix:1608-1622 declares Python/PyYAML and pkgs.nix as nativeBuildInputs and invokes this script without NIX_CONFIG or explicit experimental features.

Read-only reproduction: env NIX_CONF_DIR=/nonexistent NIX_USER_CONF_FILES=/dev/null NIX_CONFIG= nix eval --json --expr '1' fails with: error: experimental Nix feature 'nix-command' is disabled; add '--extra-experimental-features nix-command' to enable it. This is a native CLI reproduction, not a Linux derivation result.

testing_gaps: Linux owner builds and the new audit-proof-mutations matrix, including the Tailscale KVM case, were not executed in this review because a Linux/KVM builder is unavailable. Native CLI reproductions and source inspection do not establish those checks pass.
